title: Genetic and Phenotypic Effects of Chromosome Segments Introgressed From Gossypium barbadense into Gossypium hirsutum
author: Weiwu Song
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jgwcjxe
materials: Precipitate DNA with 500 μl of cold isopropanol.

steps.title: Grind leaf tissue
steps.instruction: Place about two leaf pieces in a micro‑fuge tube and grind them gently with the freezing grinding machine (MM400).

steps.title: Add preheated CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Add 700 µl of CTAB buffer that has been pre‑heated in a 65 °C water bath to the ground tissue.

steps.title: Incubate extraction mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the CTAB‑plant extract mixture for approximately 45 min at 65 °C in a recirculating water bath.

steps.title: Perform chloroform extraction and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform/iso‑amyl alcohol (24:1) to the tube, mix for about 3 min, then centrifuge at 12 000 g for 15 min to pellet cell debris.

steps.title: Collect aqueous DNA phase
steps.instruction: Transfer only the upper aqueous phase (which contains the DNA) to a clean micro‑fuge tube.

steps.title: Precipitate and wash DNA
steps.instruction: After precipitation, gently rotate or spin a pipette tip in the cold solution to collect the DNA pellet, then add 500 µl of ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, invert slowly to wash, and repeat the wash.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in water
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed DNA pellet in sterile DNase‑free water.

steps.title: Prepare PCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: In each well of a 96‑well plate combine: 6.2 µl water, 1.2 µl DNA template, 0.5 µl forward primer, 0.5 µl reverse primer, 0.5 µl dNTP mix, 1 µl 10× PCR buffer, and 0.1 µl Taq DNA polymerase.

steps.title: Run PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Place the 96‑well plate in a PCR machine with a heated lid and run the appropriate program.

steps.title: Prepare polyacrylamide gel
steps.instruction: Pour the gel mixture into the casting plate carefully to avoid bubbles, insert the comb, and allow polymerisation for about 1 hour. Then pour 1× TBE buffer into the electrophoresis chamber and remove the comb.

steps.title: Load samples onto gel
steps.instruction: Load 1.2 µl of each PCR product into individual wells of the polymerised gel.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the gel until the dark blue tracking dye runs off the bottom of the gel (or as appropriate).

steps.title: Remove gel from apparatus
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the gel and separate the plates using a single‑edged razor blade.

steps.title: Fix gel in fixer solution
steps.instruction: Place the gel in a tray containing fixer (400 ml H₂O + 50 ml 90 % ethanol + 30 ml 10 % acetic acid) and shake in a fume hood for 10 min, then pour off the fixer.

steps.title: Wash gel with water
steps.instruction: Wash the gel with water and pour off the wash water.

steps.title: Silver stain gel
steps.instruction: Add silver‑stain solution (0.9 g AgNO₃ + 300 ml H₂O) to the gel and shake for 12 min.

steps.title: Wash gel post‑stain
steps.instruction: Wash the gel with water, rinse again, and pour off the water.

steps.title: Develop gel bands
steps.instruction: Agitate the gel in developer solution (6 g NaOH + 7 ml methanol + 5 ml 0.2 % Na₂S₂O₃ + 400 ml H₂O) until band development is sufficient.

steps.title: Final water rinse
steps.instruction: Rinse the developed gel thoroughly with water.

steps.title: Image gel
steps.instruction: Scan the gel with a flat‑bed scanner or photograph it for documentation.
